c1-04-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Granting the Point
c1-04-01.scenario: In a debate, an opponent says your proposal is very popular.
c1-04-01.prompt: Grant that it is popular, then say it is risky.
c1-04-01.target: Bármennyire is népszerű a javaslat, a megvalósítása nagy kockázatokkal jár.
c1-04-01.english: However popular the proposal is, carrying it out involves great risks.
c1-04-01.canDo: I can grant an opponent's point with bármennyire is and then refute it.

c1-04-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rejecting an Assumption
c1-04-02.scenario: A reporter asks whether you admit that the project failed.
c1-04-02.prompt: Reject the assumption and say the results are good.
cues: Say what the results are like
c1-04-02.english: Far from it! The results so far are good.
c1-04-02.canDo: I can reject a wrong assumption with korántsem.

c1-04-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Absurd Consequence
c1-04-03.scenario: The chair of the debate asks why you cannot accept the opponent's principle.
c1-04-03.prompt: Show what absurd result the principle would lead to.
c1-04-03.target: Ha elfogadnánk ezt az elvet, abból az következne, hogy a törvények többé nem számítanak.
c1-04-03.english: If we accepted this principle, it would follow that the laws no longer count.
c1-04-03.canDo: I can show that a thesis leads to an absurd result.

c1-04-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Question for the Audience
c1-04-04.scenario: You speak at a public meeting about a historic moment.
c1-04-04.prompt: Ask the audience a rhetorical question about silence.
c1-04-04.target: Vajon helyes-e a hallgatás egy ilyen történelmi pillanatban?
c1-04-04.english: Is silence right at such a historic moment?
c1-04-04.canDo: I can ask a rhetorical question to corner an opponent (vajon joggal állítható-e?).

c1-04-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Ady and His Anger
c1-04-05.scenario: After reading the text about Ady Endre, a classmate asks why he attacked his country so hard.
c1-04-05.prompt: Tell your classmate what the text says.
cues: Say why, according to the text
c1-04-05.target: A szöveg szerint Ady azért ostorozta a hazáját, mert forrón szerette a nemzetét.
c1-04-05.english: According to the text, Ady scourged his homeland because he loved his nation fervently.
c1-04-05.canDo: I can follow a short text about Ady Endre's political journalism.

c1-04-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Winning the Debate
c1-04-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a debate, the chair asks you to sum up your case.
c1-04-consolidation.prompt: Grant a point, then refute it and say the reforms cannot wait.
c1-04-consolidation.target: Bármennyire is vonzó az elképzelés, mégis tarthatatlan; a reformok ügye elodázhatatlan feladattá vált.
c1-04-consolidation.english: However attractive the idea, it is untenable; the matter of the reforms has become an urgent task.
c1-04-consolidation.canDo: I can grant a point and then refute it.
